story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Water Adventure
story_info.subtitle: Staying Healthy and Hydrated
story_info.moral: Drinking water helps you feel happy and strong.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

cover.visual_action: Penny Penguin happily holds a sparkly blue water bottle

slides.title: Penny's Sunny Start
slides.text: Penny Penguin loved Saturdays! She woke up feeling happy and full of energy. "Time to play!" she chirped. She zoomed outside to Snowy Shores. The sun was bright. She wanted to play hide-and-seek with her shadow. Penny felt very excited.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny's happy start to a Saturday, ready to play.

slides.title: Playing on Snowy Shores
slides.text: Penny ran fast across the icy ground. She waddled and tumbled. Her black-and-white feathers gleamed. She giggled as her shadow tried to keep up. Playing was such fun! She did many happy hops. Penny felt very sporty today.
slides.speaker_notes: Show Penny playing energetically, highlighting her sporty nature.

slides.title: A Little Dry Feeling
slides.text: After a lot of play, Penny felt a bit tired. Her beak felt dry. "Oh dear!" she thought. "I need something." She stopped hopping. Penny remembered her special saying. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" It was important to remember.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce the small challenge: Penny feeling thirsty and remembering her catchphrase.

slides.title: Finding the Water
slides.text: Penny remembered her water bottle. She had left it near a big ice rock. She waddled quickly to find it. "There it is!" she said with a smile. It was blue and sparkly. She opened it up. Penny was happy to see her bottle.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny finds her water bottle, showing her problem-solving.

slides.title: Feeling Fresh Again
slides.text: Penny took a big, long sip of cool water. Ahh, that felt so good! Her dry beak felt fresh again. Her energy came back. "Now I can play more!" she cheered. Drinking water makes her body happy and strong. Penny was ready for more fun!
slides.speaker_notes: The solution: Penny drinks water and feels better, reinforcing the healthy habit.
